en.appSub: Indian recipes mapped to IDDSI levels
en.introTitle: Cook the level the therapist prescribed
en.introText: Pick a drink or food level to see Indian recipes made to that texture and the quick check to do before every serving.
en.ladderNote: Level 7 (easy to chew and regular foods) is not covered here.
en.none: No recipes match. Clear the search or pick another level.
en.langNote: Recipe steps are in English for now. Dish names are shown in your language.
en.flowTitle: Drink thickness check: IDDSI flow test
en.flowHow: Fill a 10 mL slip-tip syringe with the drink, block the tip, then let it flow for 10 seconds. Enter what is left in the syringe.
en.flowBoundary: Right on a boundary. Repeat the test before deciding.
en.flowL3note: For level 4, use the fork drip and spoon tilt tests instead.
en.riskTitle: Foods that carry a choking risk
en.riskIntro: Avoid these unless the speech-language pathologist has cleared them. Indian examples are shown.
en.sheetIntro: Add recipes with the button on each card, fill in the details, then print or save as PDF to hand to the family.
en.pCodeHint: Use a code, not a name.
en.sheetEmpty: No recipes on the sheet yet. Use “Add to diet sheet” on a recipe card.
en.confirmClear: Clear the diet sheet on this device?
en.printAlways: Always test each batch before serving. If coughing, a wet voice or breathlessness occurs during meals, stop and contact the therapist.
en.disclaimer: For families and clinicians working with a speech-language pathologist. It does not replace a swallowing assessment. Check every batch with the IDDSI test before serving.

kn.introText: ಪಾನೀಯ ಅಥವಾ ಆಹಾರದ ಹಂತವನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ. ಆ ಸಾಂದ್ರತೆಯ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಅಡುಗೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬಡಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಮಾಡಬೇಕಾದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
kn.ladderNote: ಹಂತ 7 (ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಅಗಿಯುವ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಆಹಾರ) ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಇಲ್ಲ.
kn.none: ಯಾವುದೂ ಹೊಂದುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ. ಹುಡುಕಾಟ ತೆರವುಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಅಥವಾ ಬೇರೆ ಹಂತ ಆರಿಸಿ.
kn.langNote: ಅಡುಗೆ ವಿಧಾನ ಸದ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಖಾದ್ಯದ ಹೆಸರುಗಳು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿವೆ.
kn.flowTitle: ಪಾನೀಯದ ದಪ್ಪ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ: IDDSI ಹರಿವು ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ
kn.flowHow: 10 mL ಸ್ಲಿಪ್-ಟಿಪ್ ಸಿರಿಂಜ್‌ಗೆ ಪಾನೀಯ ತುಂಬಿಸಿ, ತುದಿ ಮುಚ್ಚಿ, ನಂತರ 10 ಸೆಕೆಂಡು ಹರಿಯಲು ಬಿಡಿ. ಸಿರಿಂಜ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ನಮೂದಿಸಿ.
kn.flowL3note: ಹಂತ 4 ಕ್ಕೆ ಫೋರ್ಕ್ ಡ್ರಿಪ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಪೂನ್ ಟಿಲ್ಟ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಬಳಸಿ.
kn.riskIntro: ವಾಕ್-ಭಾಷಾ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸಕರು ಅನುಮತಿಸದ ಹೊರತು ಇವುಗಳನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿ. ಭಾರತೀಯ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ.
kn.sheetIntro: ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಾರ್ಡ್‌ನ ಬಟನ್‌ನಿಂದ ಅಡುಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ, ವಿವರ ತುಂಬಿ, ನಂತರ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡಲು ಮುದ್ರಿಸಿ ಅಥವಾ PDF ಆಗಿ ಉಳಿಸಿ.
kn.sheetEmpty: ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೂ ಅಡುಗೆಗಳಿಲ್ಲ. ಅಡುಗೆ ಕಾರ್ಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ “ಆಹಾರ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ” ಬಳಸಿ.
kn.confirmClear: ಈ ಸಾಧನದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಹಾರ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಖಾಲಿ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆ?
kn.printAlways: ಬಡಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಾರಿ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ. ಊಟದ ವೇಳೆ ಕೆಮ್ಮು, ಒದ್ದೆ ಧ್ವನಿ ಅಥವಾ ಉಸಿರಾಟದ ತೊಂದರೆ ಕಂಡರೆ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸಕರನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ.
kn.disclaimer: ವಾಕ್-ಭಾಷಾ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸಕರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವೈದ್ಯರಿಗಾಗಿ. ಇದು ನುಂಗುವಿಕೆ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನಕ್ಕೆ ಪರ್ಯಾಯವಲ್ಲ. ಬಡಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಾರಿ IDDSI ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮಾಡಿ.
kn.iddsiCredit: IDDSI ಹಂತಗಳು, ಬಣ್ಣಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ವಿಧಾನಗಳು: © The International Dysphagia Diet Standardisation Initiative 2016, iddsi.org/framework, CC BY-SA 4.0. ಈ ಆ್ಯಪ್ IDDSI ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದ್ದು ಅಥವಾ ಅನುಮೋದಿಸಿದ್ದು ಅಲ್ಲ.

te.introText: పానీయం లేదా ఆహార స్థాయిని ఎంచుకోండి. ఆ గట్టిదనంలో భారతీయ వంటకాలు, వడ్డించే ముందు చేయాల్సిన పరీక్ష కనిపిస్తాయి.
te.ladderNote: స్థాయి 7 (సులభంగా నమిలే, సాధారణ ఆహారం) ఇక్కడ లేదు.
te.none: ఏదీ సరిపోలలేదు. శోధన తొలగించండి లేదా వేరే స్థాయి ఎంచుకోండి.
te.langNote: వంట విధానం ప్రస్తుతం ఇంగ్లీష్‌లో ఉంది. వంటకాల పేర్లు మీ భాషలో ఉన్నాయి.
te.flowTitle: పానీయం చిక్కదనం పరీక్ష: IDDSI ఫ్లో టెస్ట్
te.flowHow: 10 mL స్లిప్-టిప్ సిరంజిలో పానీయం నింపి, కొనను మూసి, తర్వాత 10 సెకన్లు ప్రవహించనివ్వండి. సిరంజిలో మిగిలినది నమోదు చేయండి.
te.flowBoundary: సరిగ్గా సరిహద్దులో ఉంది. నిర్ణయించే ముందు మళ్లీ పరీక్షించండి.
te.flowL3note: స్థాయి 4 కోసం ఫోర్క్ డ్రిప్, స్పూన్ టిల్ట్ పరీక్షలు వాడండి.
te.riskIntro: స్పీచ్-లాంగ్వేజ్ పాథాలజిస్ట్ అనుమతించకపోతే వీటిని నివారించండి. భారతీయ ఉదాహరణలు ఇవ్వబడ్డాయి.
te.sheetIntro: ప్రతి కార్డులోని బటన్‌తో వంటకాలు చేర్చి, వివరాలు నింపి, కుటుంబానికి ఇవ్వడానికి ప్రింట్ చేయండి లేదా PDFగా సేవ్ చేయండి.
te.sheetEmpty: పట్టికలో ఇంకా వంటకాలు లేవు. వంటకం కార్డులో “ఆహార పట్టికకు చేర్చు” వాడండి.
te.confirmClear: ఈ పరికరంలో ఆహార పట్టిక ఖాళీ చేయాలా?
te.printAlways: వడ్డించే ముందు ప్రతిసారి పరీక్షించండి. భోజనం సమయంలో దగ్గు, తడి గొంతు లేదా ఆయాసం వస్తే ఆపి థెరపిస్ట్‌ను సంప్రదించండి.
te.disclaimer: స్పీచ్-లాంగ్వేజ్ పాథాలజిస్ట్‌తో పనిచేసే కుటుంబాలు, వైద్యుల కోసం. ఇది మింగుడు అంచనాకు ప్రత్యామ్నాయం కాదు. వడ్డించే ముందు ప్రతిసారి IDDSI పరీక్ష చేయండి.
te.iddsiCredit: IDDSI స్థాయిలు, రంగులు, పరీక్షా విధానాలు: © The International Dysphagia Diet Standardisation Initiative 2016, iddsi.org/framework, CC BY-SA 4.0. ఈ యాప్‌ను IDDSI తయారు చేయలేదు, ఆమోదించలేదు.

hi.appSub: IDDSI स्तरों के अनुसार भारतीय व्यंजन
hi.introTitle: थेरेपिस्ट द्वारा बताए स्तर पर ही पकाएँ
hi.introText: पेय या भोजन का स्तर चुनें। उस बनावट के भारतीय व्यंजन और परोसने से पहले की जाने वाली जाँच दिखेगी।
hi.ladderNote: स्तर 7 (आसानी से चबाने वाला और सामान्य भोजन) यहाँ शामिल नहीं है।
hi.none: कोई व्यंजन नहीं मिला। खोज हटाएँ या दूसरा स्तर चुनें।
hi.langNote: बनाने की विधि अभी अंग्रेज़ी में है। व्यंजनों के नाम आपकी भाषा में हैं।
hi.flowTitle: पेय की गाढ़ापन जाँच: IDDSI फ़्लो टेस्ट
hi.flowHow: 10 mL स्लिप-टिप सिरिंज में पेय भरें, सिरा बंद करें, फिर 10 सेकंड बहने दें। सिरिंज में बचा हुआ मान दर्ज करें।
hi.flowRange: 0 से 10 के बीच संख्या दर्ज करें।
hi.flowBoundary: ठीक सीमा पर है। निर्णय से पहले जाँच दोहराएँ।
hi.flowL3note: स्तर 4 के लिए फ़ोर्क ड्रिप और स्पून टिल्ट टेस्ट करें।
hi.riskTitle: दम घुटने के जोखिम वाले खाद्य पदार्थ
hi.riskIntro: जब तक स्पीच-लैंग्वेज पैथोलॉजिस्ट अनुमति न दें, इनसे बचें। भारतीय उदाहरण दिए गए हैं।
hi.sheetIntro: हर कार्ड के बटन से व्यंजन जोड़ें, विवरण भरें, फिर परिवार को देने के लिए प्रिंट करें या PDF सहेजें।
hi.sheetEmpty: सूची में अभी कोई व्यंजन नहीं। व्यंजन कार्ड पर “आहार सूची में जोड़ें” दबाएँ।
hi.confirmClear: इस डिवाइस पर आहार सूची खाली करें?
hi.printAlways: हर बार परोसने से पहले जाँचें। भोजन के दौरान खाँसी, गीली आवाज़ या साँस फूलने पर रुकें और थेरेपिस्ट से संपर्क करें।
hi.disclaimer: स्पीच-लैंग्वेज पैथोलॉजिस्ट के साथ काम करने वाले परिवारों और चिकित्सकों के लिए। यह निगलने के मूल्यांकन का विकल्प नहीं है। परोसने से पहले हर बार IDDSI जाँच करें।
hi.iddsiCredit: IDDSI स्तर, रंग और जाँच विधियाँ: © The International Dysphagia Diet Standardisation Initiative 2016, iddsi.org/framework, CC BY-SA 4.0। यह ऐप IDDSI द्वारा बनाया या अनुमोदित नहीं है।

LEVELS.name: lv0
LEVELS.test: Flow test: less than 1 mL left in the 10 mL syringe after 10 seconds.
LEVELS.who: Flows like water. Can be taken from any cup or straw.

LEVELS.name: lv1
LEVELS.test: Flow test: 1 to 4 mL left after 10 seconds.
LEVELS.who: Thicker than water. Flows through a straw and teat.

LEVELS.name: lv2
LEVELS.test: Flow test: 4 to 8 mL left after 10 seconds.
LEVELS.who: Flows off a spoon. Takes mild effort to drink through a standard straw.

LEVELS.name: lv3d
LEVELS.test: Flow test: more than 8 mL left after 10 seconds. Drips slowly through fork prongs.
LEVELS.who: Can be drunk from a cup with effort, or taken with a spoon. Too thick for a straw.

LEVELS.name: lv4d
LEVELS.test: Fork drip and spoon tilt tests (as for level 4 food).
LEVELS.who: Usually eaten with a spoon. Cannot be drunk from a cup or sucked through a straw.

LEVELS.name: lv3f
LEVELS.test: Fork drip: drips slowly in dollops through the prongs. Pours easily from a spoon when tilted. No lumps.
LEVELS.who: Smooth, no lumps, no chewing. Can be drunk from a cup or taken with a spoon.

LEVELS.name: lv4f
LEVELS.test: Fork drip: sits in a mound above the fork, at most a small tail below. Spoon tilt: holds its shape and slides off with little left behind. Not firm or sticky.
LEVELS.who: Smooth with no lumps. No chewing. Eaten with a spoon.

LEVELS.name: lv5
LEVELS.test: Fork pressure: easily squashed. Particles fit between the fork prongs (adults up to 4 mm, children up to 2 mm). Spoon tilt: slides off easily. No thin liquid leaking out.
LEVELS.who: Soft and moist with small lumps that need very little chewing.

LEVELS.name: lv6
LEVELS.test: Fork pressure: a thumbnail-sized piece squashes and does not regain its shape when pressed until the thumbnail blanches. Pieces no bigger than 1.5 cm for adults (8 mm for children).
LEVELS.who: Soft, tender and moist. Needs chewing but no biting.

RECIPES.name: Thickened spiced buttermilk
ing: Pinch of salt and roasted cumin powder (finely ground)
Gum-based thickener, as per the product's chart for level 2
steps: Blend the buttermilk so no curd lumps remain. Strain through a fine tea strainer.
Stir in salt and cumin powder. Do not add chopped coriander, ginger bits or curry leaves.
Add thickener exactly as the product chart says for level 2 (mildly thick). Whisk well.
Wait the time the product label states (often 1–5 minutes) before testing.
RECIPES.check: Flow test: 4–8 mL left after 10 seconds.
RECIPES.watch: Buttermilk can separate on standing. Stir and re-test if kept for more than an hour.

RECIPES.name: Strained clear rasam
ing: Gum-based thickener, as per the product chart for level 2
steps: Strain the rasam twice through a fine strainer. Remove every tomato piece, dal grain, seed and leaf.
Let it cool to warm (very hot liquids can test thinner).
Add thickener as the chart says for level 2 and whisk.
Wait as per the label, then test at serving temperature.
RECIPES.check: Flow test: 4–8 mL left after 10 seconds.
RECIPES.watch: Never serve rasam poured over rice. Thin liquid with solids (mixed consistency) is high risk.

RECIPES.name: Thickened tender coconut water
ing: Gum-based thickener, as per the product chart for level 1
steps: Strain out any coconut flesh pieces.
Add thickener as the chart says for level 1 (slightly thick). Whisk well.
Wait as per the label, then test.
RECIPES.check: Flow test: 1–4 mL left after 10 seconds.
RECIPES.watch: Use the tender coconut flesh only if separately pureed and the food level allows it.

RECIPES.name: Smooth mango lassi
ing: ½ cup ripe mango pulp (no fibres)
steps: Blend curd, mango pulp, milk and sugar until completely smooth.
Pass through a fine strainer to remove mango fibres.
Test. If too thin, add more curd and blend; if too thick, add milk a spoon at a time.
RECIPES.check: Flow test: 4–8 mL left for level 2. Thickness varies with the curd and mango, so test every batch.
RECIPES.watch: Natural thickness changes as it chills. Test at the temperature you will serve.

RECIPES.name: Ragi malt
steps: Mix the ragi flour in ¼ cup cold water to a smooth paste with no lumps.
Bring the rest of the water or milk to a boil and stir in the paste.
Cook on low heat for 5–7 minutes, stirring all the time.
Add jaggery or salt. Strain if any lumps remain.
Cool to serving temperature, then test. Add more flour (cooked again) if too thin; add warm liquid if too thick.
RECIPES.check: Flow test: more than 8 mL left after 10 seconds, and it drips slowly through a fork.
RECIPES.watch: Ragi keeps thickening as it cools. Starch drinks can also thin in the mouth with saliva, so ask the therapist whether natural thickening is suitable for this patient.

RECIPES.name: Liquidised moong dal
ing: ½ cup moong dal, pressure-cooked very soft
steps: Pressure-cook the dal until fully mashed (4–5 whistles).
Blend with water until completely smooth.
Strain through a fine strainer.
Add ghee in which cumin was heated, then strain the cumin out. Do not add whole seeds or leaves.
Adjust with water until it pours easily from a spoon.
RECIPES.check: Fork drip: drips slowly in dollops through the prongs. Pours from a spoon. No lumps.
RECIPES.watch: Dal thickens as it cools. Re-test before each serving and loosen with warm water.

RECIPES.name: Pureed curd rice
ing: ½ cup rice, cooked very soft
steps: Cook the rice with extra water until very soft.
Blend the warm rice with milk until smooth, then blend in the curd and salt.
Strain or blend again until no grains remain.
For flavour, heat ghee with mustard and curry leaves, then strain the seasoning out completely.
RECIPES.check: Spoon tilt: holds its shape on the spoon and slides off with little left behind. Not sticky. No grains.
RECIPES.watch: Rice purée turns sticky and firm on standing. Make fresh and add curd if it becomes gluey.

RECIPES.name: Pureed khichdi
steps: Pressure-cook rice, dal and vegetables with 4 times the water until very soft.
Blend to a completely smooth purée, adding hot water if needed.
Strain through a sieve to remove skins and grains.
Stir in a little ghee.
RECIPES.check: Fork drip: sits in a mound with no more than a short tail. Fork leaves a clear pattern. No lumps.
RECIPES.watch: Avoid adding whole spices or peas.

RECIPES.name: Pumpkin and dal purée
ing: 1 cup yellow pumpkin, peeled and seeded
Salt, turmeric, a little tamarind water
steps: Pressure-cook pumpkin and dal until very soft.
Blend until smooth with a little tamarind water and salt.
Strain to remove any fibres or skin.
RECIPES.check: Spoon tilt: holds its shape and slides off easily. Fork drip: sits in a mound.
RECIPES.watch: Sambar powder can contain coarse bits. Use only finely ground spices.

RECIPES.name: Smooth rava payasa
steps: Roast the rava lightly in ghee.
Add milk and cook, stirring, until soft and thick.
Add sugar and cardamom powder.
Blend until smooth. Leave out nuts and raisins.
RECIPES.check: Spoon tilt: holds its shape and slides off. Not sticky.
RECIPES.watch: Thickens a lot as it cools. Loosen with warm milk and re-test.

RECIPES.name: Banana and papaya purée
ing: ½ cup ripe papaya, seeds removed
steps: Blend the fruit until completely smooth.
Add curd or milk only if needed to loosen.
Serve fresh.
RECIPES.check: Spoon tilt: holds its shape and slides off. Fork drip: sits in a mound.
RECIPES.watch: Fruit purées can release juice on standing. Stir and re-test; do not serve if liquid separates.

RECIPES.name: Idli mashed in thick sambar
ing: ½ cup sambar, blended smooth and strained
steps: Blend the sambar and strain out vegetable pieces, seeds and leaves.
Mash the idlis with a fork into the hot sambar until moist throughout.
Leave to soak for 2 minutes, then mash again until lumps are smaller than 4 mm.
RECIPES.check: Fork pressure: squashes easily. Spoon tilt: slides off. No thin liquid pooling around it.
RECIPES.watch: Dry or day-old idli is crumbly and high risk. Serve fresh and well soaked.

RECIPES.name: Minced fish in smooth curry
ing: 100 g boneless fish (e.g. seer or pomfret fillet)
½ cup fish curry gravy, blended smooth
steps: Steam or poach the fish until it flakes easily.
Check carefully by hand for every bone.
Mince finely with a fork (pieces up to 4 mm).
Mix with the smooth gravy until moist throughout.
RECIPES.check: Fork pressure: squashes easily. Spoon tilt: slides off. No separated liquid.
RECIPES.watch: Fish bones are a serious hazard. Check twice.

RECIPES.name: Soft rava upma
steps: Roast the rava lightly.
Boil the water with salt and grated carrot, then add rava and cook until very soft.
Leave out cashews, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds and curry leaves, or strain them out of the seasoning.
Add warm water or ghee to keep it moist.
RECIPES.check: Fork pressure: squashes easily. Falls off a spoon when tilted. Not crumbly or dry.
RECIPES.watch: Upma dries and turns crumbly as it cools. Serve warm and moist.

RECIPES.name: Soft vegetable kurma
ing: Smooth kurma gravy (coconut and spices blended fine)
steps: Cut vegetables into pieces no bigger than 1.5 cm.
Cook until a fork squashes them easily.
Simmer in smooth gravy. Leave out peas, beans, drumstick and corn.
RECIPES.check: Fork pressure: each piece squashes and stays squashed. Pieces 1.5 cm or smaller.
RECIPES.watch: Beans and drumstick are stringy and high risk. Leave them out.

RECIPES.name: Tender chicken curry
steps: Pressure-cook the chicken in the gravy until very tender.
Cut into pieces no bigger than 1.5 cm, removing all skin, gristle and bone.
Keep the pieces coated in gravy so they stay moist.
RECIPES.check: Fork pressure: a piece breaks apart easily and does not spring back.
RECIPES.watch: Chicken dries and toughens if reheated. Add gravy and re-test.

RISK: Groundnuts, roasted chana, chakli, murukku, boondi, dry chapati or roti, khakhra
Crisp dosa, papad, mixture, rusk, dry biscuits, chikki
Thick sticky rice, sticky sweets, toffee, chewing gum, nut butter
Drumstick, beans, raw mango, sugarcane, jackfruit, tough meat
Mustard seeds and curry leaves in tempering, whole spices, guava seeds, grape skins, coconut pieces
Rasam or sambar with rice, cereal or cornflakes in milk, soup with vegetable pieces
Raw salad leaves, thin cucumber slices, watermelon, oranges
